item.title: Fixing uFeature app binary sizes
item.description: Porting an app to a uFeature architecture leads to a doubling in binary size. Why? How can we fix it?
item.author: jack@youstra.com (Jack Youstra)

item.title: TCA test recording
item.description: If you record all of the actions in an app, assert all of the states at every step, and record all of the side effects, you can replay the recording in a test and verify that the app behaves the same way and investigate why. This is a post about how I built a test recorder for TCA.
item.author: jack@youstra.com (Jack Youstra)

item.title: Not all apps are born with a tap
item.description: No test facilities? Edge cases that are hard to reproduce but most apps run into? Just another day on Apple's wild ride.
